summary: Iteration 37 - Course Analytics Dashboard + Send Message E2E. All backend (7/7) and frontend critical flows passing after one small bug fix. Fixed a TypeError on /api/analytics/course-dashboard for teacher scope (mixed datetime/string comparison in max()).

issues: Test org has 7 courses but 0 enrolled_students (per_course.enrolled all 0). Charts/cards correctly render zeros (no UI crash) but main agent may want to seed enrollments for a richer demo state.

action_items: (Optional) Seed enrolled_students + quiz_results for test.orgadmin's courses to populate at_risk/top_students/engagement_trend with non-zero data.
(Optional) Add data-testid attributes on TeacherMessagingPage (student-card, message-input, send-message-btn, message-bubble) for more stable future tests.
critical_code_review_comments: Bug fixed in /app/backend/server.py line ~7771 (get_course_analytics_dashboard): max(last_quiz, last_user_active) compared a str against a datetime when user.last_login is stored as native datetime in Mongo, causing 500. Now both values are normalized via isoformat() before max(). This was reproducible 100% for the teacher scope.
Endpoint is correct in role-aware scoping (returns 403 for student, scope='teacher' for teacher, scope='organization' for org_admin).

Response shape matches spec exactly: summary has all 8 keys; engagement_trend has 14 daily buckets; per_course rows include course_id, course_name, enrolled, completed, completion_rate, pass_rate, avg_grade, quiz_attempts.
MessageCreate model + POST /api/messages + GET /api/messages/conversation/{user_id} all working as expected; notification is dispatched via send_notification.
CourseAnalyticsDashboardPage.js correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and Bearer token from localStorage cognify_token.
TeacherMessagingPage uses fetch (legacy) - works but inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses axios. Not blocking.
seed_data_creation: Sent TEST_ prefixed messages from org_admin to demo.student during E2E test (visible in conversation). No other seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Course Analytics Dashboard endpoint and page are fully working. Bug found and fixed: in server.py around line 7771, datetime from user.last_login was being compared with string from quiz_results.completed_at via max(); fix normalizes via isoformat helper. Test data note: the org's courses currently have no enrolled_students/quiz_results so summary values are zero, but the dashboard renders gracefully (cards, charts, empty states). TeacherMessagingPage send flow works end-to-end (E2E test message visible in conversation UI; backend test confirmed message persisted and round-trips through /api/messages/conversation/{user_id}).

features_tested.POST /api/messages + GET /api/messages/c: PASS (both org_admin and student sides see the message)
features_tested.Frontend /teacher-messaging Send Message: PASS - message appears in chat thread

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: In get_course_analytics_dashboard, max(last_quiz, last_user_active) compared a string (quiz_results.completed_at stored as isoformat string) against a datetime object (users.last_login stored natively). Python raises TypeError: '>' not supported between instances of 'datetime.datetime' and 'str'.
rca_of_the_issue.fix: Added inline _to_str helper that calls .isoformat() on datetime values before they are passed to max(). Both last_quiz and last_user_active now normalized to strings.
